The duplicate can flank, can strike incorporeal but not ethereal creatures, and can teleport up to 30 feet to a new target when you spend a standard action. It has AC 10 + your size modifier + the same spell-save modifier and one-fifth your normal maximum hp.

spells/tornado-throw-3681.name: Tornado Throw
spells/tornado-throw-3681.effectSummary: As a full-round maneuver, move up to double speed and, after each 10 feet moved, attempt a throw against a target after succeeding on a melee touch attack. Resolve each throw as a trip without provoking or permitting a counter-trip, using Strength or Dexterity and gaining +2 on the check per 5 feet moved that turn. Success throws the target 10 feet, leaves it prone, and deals 2d6 damage; every 5 points of check margin adds 5 feet of throw distance and 1d6 damage. Thrown movement provokes no attacks of opportunity.

spells/last-breath-1911.name: Last Breath
spells/last-breath-1911.effectSummary: Returns a willing creature that died within the last round to 0 hp. You take 1d4 damage per subject Hit Die that spell resistance cannot prevent. Ability scores at 0 or lower rise to 1; normal poison and disease are cured, while magical disease, curses, and missing body parts remain. The subject loses one level, or 1 Constitution if previously 1st level, and may lose prepared spells or unused slots accordingly. It cannot restore death-effect victims, constructs, elementals, outsiders, undead, or creatures that died of old age.

spells/obedient-avalanche-648.name: Obedient Avalanche
spells/obedient-avalanche-648.effectSummary: Creates an avalanche centered at range. Creatures within 20 feet take 1d8 damage per two caster levels, maximum 10d8, plus 1d6 cold per two caster levels; Reflex halves and failure also buries them. From 20 to 40 feet, creatures take half the inner-ring impact damage, Reflex negates, and on failure are bull-rushed away by the snow with a +13 check bonus. The inner area becomes heavy snow, the outer ring light snow, small vegetation is uprooted, rubble remains after melting, structures take 1d6×10 damage, and all touched flames are extinguished.

spells/spell-flower-3242.name: Spell Flower
spells/spell-flower-3242.effectSummary: For 1 round per caster level, lets you hold one touch-spell charge in each forelimb. A held spell remains until that limb casts another spell or touches something; another touch spell cast with that limb can replace the lost charge. You can deliver different held touch spells with different limbs, including off-hand touch attacks with normal two-weapon penalties. When Spell Flower ends, only the most recently cast held touch spell remains; all others dissipate.
